name: Proton Saga
summary: The third-generation Proton Saga sedan in its 2019 facelift.

source.note: KL Rush vehicle art, declared CC0-1.0 in the game’s own records. Its surface maps are the colour, normal and ORM maps every KL Rush car shares, baked from the Rimba SUV (the Proton X50).

notes: Compressed for the web (meshopt geometry, KTX2 textures). The car’s paint and shading were set in code; here they are rebuilt as standard glTF materials, without dirt, dust and lamp glow. A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.

credits.note: Modelled on photos of the real car; design rights unchecked. Made by scripted agents.
